review_notes: I read the whole file and grepped Mathlib for `rangeSingleton` and `rangeIcc`. The only other `rangeIcc` is `DFinsupp.rangeIcc` in Mathlib/Data/DFinsupp/Interval.lean. It is the parallel construction for dependent finsupps, a different type, so I don't count it as a competing version. `Finsupp.rangeSingleton` is a named wrapper. It could be written with `Finsupp.mapRange` and `Finset.singleton`, but the rubric says implementing a named API through a generic map doesn't make it redundant. The only other use I found is `mem_rangeSingleton_apply_iff` in the file itself. `coe_rangeIcc` repeats the `@[simps apply]` lemma, but that is theorem-level duplication, which the rubric excludes. The `LocallyFiniteOrder` instance is built with `LocallyFiniteOrder.ofIcc`, as intended. I found no competing concept to report. I did not check whether Mathlib has a more general pointwise-`Finset` finsupp construction beyond these searches, so some uncertainty remains.
